description: Starts publishing an audio file you already have (audio/mpeg, audio/mp4, audio/aac, audio/wav or audio/x-m4a, up to 1 GiB). The uploaded bytes must really be that type, or complete_episode rejects them. Returns upload URLs: PUT each part with its length, then call complete_episode. Reusing idempotencyKey returns the same episode, even after it has published; a retry never makes a second episode and never charges again. A reply with a parts list is a fresh or still-open hold to upload. A replay with no parts means the episode already exists and must not be uploaded: it carries episode with the current status, so call read_episode.
name: hold_episode
title: Start upload
